args.title: Freight Pricing Summary (Juniper blog + companion)
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least (companion piece).

Sources: https://blog.juniper.example/2026/freight ; https://insights.juniper.example/freight/companion
